text:
I have a local delivery address in the UAE and can help with your eCommerce test buy by placing the order, capturing the confirmation, and documenting the packaging and product condition exactly as requested.

I’m Mina Castellan, with 5 years of experience in data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization using SQL, Excel, Power BI, and Google Sheets. While my main work is analytics, I’m comfortable following detailed, structured workflows and documenting results carefully.

Relevant experience:
- Marketing attribution analysis: built a BigQuery/SQL workflow to join ad spend with GA4 sessions and compare first-click, last-click, and position-based credit; 18% of ad budget reallocated.
- A/B test readouts: built a repeatable readout template for in-app store experiments with power checks before launch; 11 experiments analysed.

I can follow your milestone steps precisely and provide clear, organized submissions.
